notes.title: Thank you for 30,000 downloads & official Discord server opened!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UcaXNK49_iw;full][/previewyoutube]
On June 16, I surpassed 3,0000 downloads and reached 65 reviews!

I am very late to report this, but I would like to thank all the observers who played the game and all those who pressed the add library button.

I am very pleased to hear from observers who enjoy the Simplified and Traditional Chinese versions!


For that, I apologize for not being able to meet the expectations of those who have been waiting for the update.

Since around June, there have been events that have interfered with our game publicity activities, and I have been very sick, both physically and mentally.
(The detailed circumstances are described in the “Severed Love” announcement.)
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3412110/view/512965256196128854

The situation is unstable, not knowing when it might improve, but thanks to your support, I are barely holding our ground.

In order to regain our motivation and confidence, I am now focusing on the development of a new spin-off work, “Severed Love”.
I would like to do our best in development so that both works, which share a common worldview, can attract players to each other and both can be enjoyed.

The new “Severed Love” is also available for a limited time through August 31 in an updated, full-voiced demo version.
And “Romp of Dump” is also free to play without mentioning it.

Let's get through this shitty summer by punishing the scumbags!

notes.title: Developer's Diary & Will attend BitSummit
notes.content:
【Delusions of a "Romp of Dump" spin-off?】
[previewyoutube=2i8hOV2draM;full][/previewyoutube]*English subtitles are available.

This is a psycho-horror otome game in which you become a victim of the "Limb-Stripping Machine Case" and spend your life in confinement for the first time.
...However, this is just a delusion.

In this prototype, we implemented a music video-style message window by customizing "Utage," a visual novel production tool for Unity.
The message window can be animated using only the same dialogue display commands as usual.

We wanted to challenge Live2D expressions that had not been used in our previous works, such as the double meaning of romance and horror, and the double meaning of a heart-pounding performance.


A bizarre criminal with an eerie and meaningful prosthetic hand with a rarefied sense of mortality.
Are there any observers out there who would like to be a part of his devotion?

If you would like to play this delusion when it becomes a game, please support us in the comments!



【"Animaloid Girl" will be exhibited at BitSummit Drift!】
[previewyoutube=rQbCeTfU4Wg;full][/previewyoutube]
"Animaloid Girl," an indie game planned, Live2D, scenario, etc. by Zakurosuke, will be exhibited at BitSummit Drift.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2545200/view/4371389992155036845

BitSummit is one of the largest indie game real events in Japan.
It will be held in Kyoto, Japan from 7/19 to 7/21.

"Animaloid Girl" will also be exhibiting its latest playable demo.
Please register your wish list as well!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545200/_/

The playable demo's revamped UI is prototypical of the one developed for the aforementioned Romp of Dump spin-off delusion.
Many other technologies developed for Romp of Dump are also used, including Live2D and Unity Utage customization.


 BitSummit official website：https://bitsummit.org/
 Click here to purchase tickets：https://bitsummit.org/ticket/



For the fans of "Animaloid Girl," I am just one of the nameless staff members.
It is no exaggeration to say that this work is built on the corpses of "Romp of Dump" and other individual productions, but few people are aware of this.


I would like as many people as possible to know about my individually produced works as well, but I am not good enough. So I have been very depressed in the past few months.

I prototyped new expressions in my spin-off delusion and updated effects in "Romp of Dump" because I have always worried that my games lacked visual appeal.


My problems have not gone away, and I have not and will not change the fact that I suffer from a lack of confidence.

I only hope that I can at least sublimate my dark feelings into my creative work, and I would appreciate your support.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/5aa9484b438809e155a819de93ac80792867a060.png
I am now only "1 week" away from the release of the Early Access version of "Romp of Dump"!

Thanks to the support of our observers, the number of Steam Wish List registrations has exceeded 【2121】!
For an unknown indie game, this is a truly honorable number.
I will do our best to release the game safely, so we hope you will watch over us.



【New contents of the Early Access version of the game!】
(The screenshots are for the Japanese version, but the English version will be implemented at the same time.)

1. Main Scenario
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/a040cc80f36b16db3b717e2c07b30f5a0cf26533.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/94829f5b73c6ac1897225911dbb127527a73bd18.jpg
The main scenario exposes the bizarre crimes committed by the scum prisoners.
Of the three episodes, the core "Episode 2" can be played to the end for all characters!

2. Event illustrations animated in Live2D
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/be19f89acbc9300c403400bd41dcecfc6aac8883.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/ef29c43ea6318b3334094c85ac0fa1d7cdd5989a.jpg
When you play the main scenario, you can see event illustrations animated in Live2D.
Depending on the stills, there are gimmicks for facial expression/motion differences and animations unique to Live2D!
*Some of the text is withheld because it is a spoiler, but the text will be disclosed in the main game!

3. Hidden Characters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/04d45a72110d96db5d8ef0cf66564ba6bfcd3f54.jpg
You can release all of the prisoners, Durum, Franbel, and Drake, whom you could only meet once in the demo version.
Hidden characters can be released in exchange for chips at the in-game "SHOP".

4. New mini-game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/5647e37536ccadeb850e449586c0b7243c795666.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/4486660a0c199f21bf907f00d7dbcd50e08ac053.jpg
Prisoner scum kick each other down without honor!
You can play a new mini-game "Poker"!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/c59348b075919187d2b3349697364faebe413b08.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/00a8a6819f4da63860c6478ebaba281772fc1746.jpg
Another final mini-game is "Ask for Baccarat".
Based on Baccarat, the game asks the prisoner who plays the dealer "three questions" and guesses the correct answer.
Sometimes the dealer lies, and sometimes the questions are unimportant.

Both mini-games can be released in exchange for chips at the "SHOP".

5. Login Bonus
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/899f748aeff39e9261e84b5b514287696b2ede8d.jpg
I will officially implement a login bonus where you can receive a chip or other rewards once a day.
Rewards will increase with cumulative and consecutive logins, so the more you log in, the more you can enjoy additional content.
The prisoner who welcomes you can also be freely changed from "CONFIG"!

6.図書館イベント
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/2a8989326ea453d462d46dca2c822b0544dda7cb.jpg
A new "Prison Library" has been added, where you can collect "case files" that will serve as hints for the mystery-solving part of the main scenario.
You can visit the library by winning the mini-game or playing the mini-game as many times as you like.

Durum, a model prisoner in charge of the library, and Franbel, a prisoner who somehow holds information related to the police.
Some of you may meet these two for the first time in the library.

7. New Penalty Game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/26de1852f6bdd8caf9d437b21743702e8aa6cc66.jpg
I have also created a new episode of the penalty game, a fun game for the losers of the mini-game!
I are adding 10 (11 for Louq only) punishments per character.

After the release, I will add more in the form of a series of episodes!

8. New Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/28e64a39badc13f384411f57f91661758e70b982.jpg
The number of gift items ejected from the "Item Lottery" that can be exchanged in the "SHOP" has been doubled from 8 to 18 types!
The item raffle will also have 10 raffle items in a row without any cover, so please try to collect them!

9.Photo Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/128a8f2d29035b1ecd14350cd65bc82cc6ebddf5.jpg
Live2D "Photo Mode" has been officially implemented! You can take two shots with all the scum prisoners.
You can play it as a kind of punishment game by releasing it in exchange for a chip at the "SHOP".

Snapshots taken in Photo Mode are welcome to be posted on SNS!
Please read the guidelines on the official website, and by all means, please share them to make the game more exciting!
Guidelines: http://zakurobento.starfree.jp/RompOfDump/#Guideline


9. Steam Achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/ff5ee3224785e18cc1e60aa92c1099c96b757dc6.png
As of Early Access, 97 Steam Achievements have been implemented!
The number of mini-games played, wins and losses, and some of them can be unlocked by slightly surprising conditions.



All of these contents can be played entirely for free.
I am in the last spurt of development so that all observers can enjoy the game.
Please download and review when I release it!
